DECIMAL.semantics: exact decimal with declared precision and scale

TIME.semantics: local time-of-day without date or time zone

TIMESTAMP.semantics: timestamp value using CPF runtime time-zone policy

renderingPolicy.databaseGeneratedIdentity: vendor identity syntax emitted only by renderer
renderingPolicy.updatedAtSemantics: canonical onUpdate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is emitted as MariaDB column clause or generated trigger for PostgreSQL/Oracle
renderingPolicy.oracleTimeOfDay: VARCHAR2(15 CHAR) with canonical HH:mm:ss[.fraction] application codec; Oracle has no native TIME-only type
